Can the Seahawks build a strong roster after a season-ending injury to Jake Bobo and a broken ankle that will sideline Bud Clark? Montorie Foster Jr. continues to surprise and delight, but futures remains unknown. Hard Knocks lead director Pat Harris joins Andrew about the tough shots, broken cameras, emotional storylines, and what makes the Seahawks stand out from other teams he’s covered.
